newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy leaded/unleaded gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy leaded/unleaded gasoline.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 95-octane leaded and unleaded gasoline for November/December deliveries, traders said on Thursday.

The tender seeks a 250,000-barrel cargo of leaded gasoline for December 1-15 delivery and 250,000-barrel cargoes of unleaded grade for November 21-30 and December 1-15 deliveries on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung.
The tender closes on October 16 and will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 250,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate around $23.80 per barrel for November 1-20 delivery, c-and-f basis.
